test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

Aryan told me that I knew where to find him.

options.text: Aryan said to me, "You know where to find me."
Aryan said to me, "You knowing where to find me."
Aryan said to me, "You are known where to find me."
Aryan says to me, "You know where to find me."

solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. Aryan said to me, "You know where to find me."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** Indirect Speech**. As per the given directions, we have to change it into **Direct Speech.**
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction** 'that'** will be removed and comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• In the direct speech **'told'** will be changed into **'said to' **because reporting verb has an object, **'me.'**
 
• Now, let's focus on the reported speech.
 
• **'I'** will be changed into **'You.'**
 
• Also, **'knew****'** will be changed into **'know.'**
 
• **'him'** will be changed into **'me.'**
 
• Finally, the result is: **Aryan said to me, "You know where to find me."**
 
• ​So, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__* **Aryan said to me, "You know where to find me."***
